item.title: Oil Prices and Stocks Swing Wildly as Iran and Israel Launch New Strikes
item.summary: Oil prices and stocks initially swung wildly, and Iran’s foreign minister promised “surprises,” calling the strikes against his country “Operation Epic Mistake.”

item.title: Iran Choosing Mojtaba Khamenei as Supreme Leader Signals Defiance Amid War
item.summary: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei could prove to be even more radical than his father and predecessor, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed by the U.S. and Israel at the start of the war.

item.title: Video Captures Apparent Strike Near Boys’ School in Iran
item.summary: A communications tower seemed to be the intended target, according to satellite imagery analysis. Iranian state media reported that a boy had been killed in the explosion.

item.title: NATO Intercepts Second Iranian Missile Entering Turkey’s Airspace, Defense Ministry Says
item.summary: It was the second time in six days that Turkey announced the interception of a missile from Iran.

item.title: Dozens Wounded in Bahrain as Arab States Condemn Iranian Strikes
item.summary: Key U.S. allies in the Persian Gulf have stepped up their criticism of Iran after facing a barrage of missiles and drone attacks over the past week.

item.title: Ed Davey Wants King Charles to Cancel his U.S. State Visit Over Iran War
item.summary: Ed Davey, the leader of the Liberal Democrats in Britain, said President Trump does not deserve the “diplomatic coup” of hosting the king for a state visit.

item.title: Israeli Forces Raid New Area in Southern Lebanon, Bombard Near Beirut
item.summary: Joseph Aoun, the Lebanese president, called for direct talks with Israel to end the fighting. He also leveled blame at Hezbollah, the Iran-backed group, for igniting the war.

item.title: Ukraine Helps U.S. Bases in the Mideast With Stopping Drones
item.summary: As the war in Iran spreads, Kyiv is eagerly offering its hard-won expertise and advanced technology to counter Iranian drones.

item.title: U.S. Tomahawk Hit Naval Base Beside Iranian School, Video Shows
item.summary: The evidence contradicts President Trump’s claim that Iran was responsible for a strike at the school that killed 175 people, most of them children.

item.title: France Is Sending a Large Naval Force to the Middle East
item.summary: President Emmanuel Macron said the warships would help protect France’s allies in the region, and could be part of a force to escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz. He said the war could continue for “several days, maybe several weeks.”
